'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tim Murray LS Rebel Strike Team (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tim Murray]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Rebel Strike Team (V) / Garrison Destroyed (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Timbed2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
